Frequently asked questions

What does the warranty cover?

Every product ships with a 1-year limited warranty against manufacturing defects. Wear and tear from normal use is not covered.

How do I return a product?

Open your account dashboard, find the order, and click "Request a return." You'll get a prepaid label by email. Returns must arrive within 30 days of delivery.

Do you ship internationally?

Yes — we ship to 47 countries. Shipping costs and estimated arrival are calculated at checkout based on your address.

Can I change or cancel my order after I've placed it?

Orders can be edited or cancelled within 1 hour of placing them. After that, the order is locked into our fulfillment queue.

Do you offer business / volume pricing?

We do — for orders of 25 units or more, contact our sales team and we'll send a custom quote within 1 business day.
